title: 9 Best Herbal Teas For Gum Infection
intro: Herbal teas for gum infection are a natural remedy that uses the extracts of various herbs to treat gum inflammation, infection, and other related oral health issues. These teas are beneficial in treating gum infection as they possess anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties that help reduce swelling, fight off infection, and promote healing. Examples of herbal teas that can be used to treat gum infection include peppermint tea, which reduces inflammation and kills bacteria; chamomile tea, which soothes and calms the gums; eucalyptus tea, which fights off infection and reduces pain; and sage tea, which reduces inflammation and promotes healing. Additionally, other herbal teas such as tea tree oil, clove tea, and licorice root tea can also be used to treat gum infection due to their antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties.
